memberships_terms_check.name: memberships_terms_check
memberships_terms_check.value: "memberships"."status" IN ('pending', 'denied') OR ("memberships"."tier_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memberships"."starts_on" IS NOT NULL)

memberships_date_order_check.name: memberships_date_order_check
memberships_date_order_check.value: "memberships"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "memberships"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "memberships"."ends_on" >= "memberships"."starts_on"
